dataset_reference: Koreeda & Manning, ContractNLI: A Dataset for Document-level Natural Language Inference for Contracts, Findings of EMNLP 2021 (2021.findings-emnlp.164)
mapping_rule: A hypothesis is mapped to a Verum detector only when that detector's rule semantics genuinely decide the hypothesis from the document text. Verum detectors measure contradictions between anchored statements inside the sealed record; none of them compares a contract against an external NDA-review hypothesis. A hypothesis with no such detector is not_applicable and is never forced onto a contradiction type.

nda-1.hypothesis: All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
nda-1.rationale: Judges whether the agreement expressly identifies confidential information against an external expectation. No Verum detector compares a document against an external NDA-completeness hypothesis; CT08 compares two defined terms inside the record.

nda-2.hypothesis: Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
nda-2.rationale: Judges the scope of a definition against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector classifies clause scope against a fixed NDA hypothesis.

nda-3.hypothesis: Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
nda-3.rationale: Judges whether a definition may cover verbal conveyance against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector implements that comparison.

nda-4.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement.
nda-4.rationale: Judges a purpose-restriction clause against an external hypothesis. Verum use/purpose semantics are not measured by any detector.

nda-5.hypothesis: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees.
nda-5.rationale: Judges a permission to share with employees against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates sharing permissions.

nda-7.hypothesis: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).
nda-7.rationale: Judges a permission to share with third parties against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates sharing permissions.

nda-8.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
nda-8.rationale: Judges whether a notice obligation exists against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector establishes the existence or absence of an obligation clause.

nda-10.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
nda-10.rationale: Judges whether the agreement's own existence is confidential against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector implements that comparison.

nda-11.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
nda-11.rationale: Judges a reverse-engineering prohibition against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this prohibition.

nda-12.hypothesis: Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.
nda-12.rationale: Judges an independent-development permission against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this permission.

nda-13.hypothesis: Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
nda-13.rationale: Judges a third-party acquirement permission against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this permission.

nda-15.hypothesis: Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
nda-15.rationale: Judges a no-rights-granted clause against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates licensing semantics.

nda-16.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.
nda-16.rationale: Judges a return-or-destroy obligation against an external hypothesis. Verum date detectors (D03/D03B/D04/D31) measure contradictions between anchored dates in the record, not whether this obligation exists.

nda-17.hypothesis: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
nda-17.rationale: Judges a copy permission against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this permission.

nda-18.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not solicit some of Disclosing Party's representatives.
nda-18.rationale: Judges a non-solicitation prohibition against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this prohibition.

nda-19.hypothesis: Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.
nda-19.rationale: Judges obligation survival against an external hypothesis. Verum expiry/termination handling measures contradictions between anchored statements, never whether a survival clause exists.

nda-20.hypothesis: Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
nda-20.rationale: Judges a post-termination retention permission against an external hypothesis. No Verum detector evaluates this permission.
